cases.name: Michelle Annette Avan
cases.about:
She was a Senior Vice President at Bank of America. Colleagues said she helped to break down the barriers against women and people of color. “She let her light shine. I walked on her coattails and I followed in her shadow,” Brent Hamlet, a colleague, said. “If I got light, it’s because Michelle shined it on me.”

https://losangeles.cbslocal.com/2021/08/14/vigil-held-for-48-year-old-banking-executive-michelle-avan-murdered-in-her-reseda-home/
cases.narrative: On 8/5/2021, a family member discovered her body in her home.
